about: Okuma threading: G71 is a multi-pass thread cycle of its own block (not the Fanuc roughing cycle), G33 cuts one pass per block and stays in force over the pass blocks, and the F of G04 is a dwell time, which is neither a feed nor a lead.

states.about: G71 starts a cycle for its own block only (a non-modal cycle start, AD-19 rule 2), and its F is the 2 mm lead.
A threading pass is a move whose feed is a lead: it becomes the cycle in force (AD-19 rule 3).
A pass block that writes only X is still a pass of that thread.
AD-19 rule 6: the F of G04 is the time the tool waits, so the feed in force is still the one the program set before.
